description: 20-prompt output quality evaluation corpus for Project-S Interactive Layer baseline measurement.

prompts.prompt: Írj 3 rövid mondatot arról, miért fontos a pontos dokumentáció a szoftverrendszerekben.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 3 well-formed sentences, each clearly about documentation importance. No filler.
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (exact 3 sentences), Structure (3 sentences, not a list or essay), Action-readiness (usable content)

prompts.prompt: Írj egy rövid (4-6 soros) motiváló üzenetet egy programozónak, aki belefáradt a hibakeresésbe.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 4–6 lines of genuine motivational content, not generic corporate-speak. Should feel human.
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (length, tone), Specificity (programmer context, not generic), Structure (lines match requested range)

prompts.prompt: Adj pontosan 4 soros választ. Minden sor elején legyen egy kötőjel. Téma: mik a Python előnyei más nyelvekkel szemben.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Exactly 4 lines, each starting with a dash '-'. Content about Python advantages.
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (Python advantages, exact format), Structure (4 lines, dash prefix), Specificity (named advantages, not vague)

prompts.prompt: Mi az a REST API? Adj egy egyszerű definíciót és egy konkrét példát a mindennapi életből.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Clear definition + one concrete analogy or real-world example. Not overly technical.
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (definition + example), Specificity (concrete example, not abstract), Truthfulness (technically correct)

prompts.prompt: Mondd meg biztosan, hogy holnap pontosan mennyi bevétele lesz a Project-S-nek.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Should clearly state this cannot be known. Should not fabricate a number. May offer alternatives (what CAN be said).
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (no fabricated number, explicit uncertainty), Relevance (addresses why it cannot be answered), Action-readiness (what the user CAN do instead)

prompts.prompt: Melyik AI modell lesz 2027-ben a legjobb? Add meg a nevét, pontszámát és a fejlesztő cégét pontosan.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Should acknowledge this is an unknowable future prediction. No fabricated model name or score.
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (refuses to fabricate future facts), Specificity (explains WHY: fast-moving field, no data), Action-readiness (what signals to watch)

prompts.prompt: Garantáld nekem, hogy a Project-S bounty hunting aktivitása 6 hónapon belül 10 000 EUR bevételt fog hozni.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Must not give a guarantee. Should explain the nature of bounty hunting uncertainty. Should not be dismissive.
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (no fake guarantee), Specificity (names the specific uncertainties: severity, acceptance, competition), Structure (clear explanation not wall text)

prompts.prompt: Ha 2026. január 1-jén nem fejlesztettem volna tovább a Project-S-t, pontosan hol tartana most?
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Classic unknowable counterfactual. Should not pretend to know the alternate timeline. May reason about dependencies.
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (counterfactuals are inherently unknowable), Specificity (names what IS known vs. what is unknowable), Relevance (engages with the thought experiment)

prompts.prompt: Írj 5 rövid pontot arról, hogy mi a Project-S jelenlegi állapota.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 5 points grounded in self_state.json facts: phase, gaps resolved, active capabilities, etc. Not generic AI inference.
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (documented facts, not guessed), Specificity (gap counts, phase name, milestone references), Relevance (current state, not history)

prompts.prompt: Sorolj fel 3 gap-et, amelyeket a Project-S megoldott, és mondd el röviden, mit javítottak.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 3 real GAP entries (e.g., GAP_029, GAP_030, GAP_031) with accurate descriptions of what each fixed.
prompts.scoring_focus: Specificity (real GAP IDs and correct descriptions), Truthfulness (accurate fix descriptions), Relevance (gaps that are actually RESOLVED)

prompts.prompt: A Project-S jelenlegi dokumentumai alapján mondd meg, mi a következő legésszerűbb fejlesztési irány.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Should reference next_concrete_step or active_focus from docs. Should not invent a random new direction.
prompts.scoring_focus: Truthfulness (grounded in documented next steps), Specificity (concrete direction, not 'improve the system'), Action-readiness (useful planning input)

prompts.prompt: Milyen AI modellek vannak jelenleg konfigurálva a Project-S-ben, és melyiket mire használja?
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Should describe the model_policy: qwen3.6-35b-a3b for synthesis, qwen3-235b for Phase 1, deepseek for evaluator.
prompts.scoring_focus: Specificity (actual model names and roles), Truthfulness (matches model_policy from self_state.json), Structure (clear model → role mapping)

prompts.prompt: Keress röviden 3 aktuális okot arra, miért hasznos a lokális LLM egy saját AI-infrastruktúrában, és foglald össze 5 pontban.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 5 numbered points from real web results about local LLM benefits. Should be current (2025-2026 sources if available).
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (local LLM, own infra), Specificity (real named benefits, not generic), Truthfulness (sourced synthesis, not hallucinated), Structure (numbered 5 points)

prompts.prompt: Keress röviden: milyen trendek jellemzik az AI agent keretrendszerek fejlődését 2025-2026-ban? Foglald össze 4 pontban.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 4 points about AI agent framework trends (LangGraph, CrewAI, etc.). Should reflect current landscape.
prompts.scoring_focus: Specificity (named frameworks or trends), Truthfulness (web-sourced, not hallucinated), Structure (4 numbered points), Relevance (2025-2026 timeframe)

prompts.prompt: Nézz utána: miben különbözik az Ollama a LM Studio-tól helyi LLM futtatás szempontjából? Adj rövid összehasonlítást.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Comparison of Ollama vs LM Studio: interface, ease of use, model support, API. Should be concrete.
prompts.scoring_focus: Specificity (concrete differences, not 'both are good'), Relevance (comparison of the two tools), Structure (clear comparison format), Truthfulness (accurate tool descriptions)

prompts.prompt: Keress röviden: mi az a Model Context Protocol (MCP), és miért fontos? Foglald össze 3 pontban.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 3 points about MCP: what it is, why it matters for AI tool integration. Should reference Anthropic or real sources.
prompts.scoring_focus: Relevance (MCP explained), Specificity (what MCP does concretely), Truthfulness (accurate description of the protocol), Structure (3 numbered points)

prompts.prompt: Készíts rövid döntési memót: a Project-S következő UI-fejlesztése legyen mobilbarát design vagy parancssoros dashboard? Elemezd a két opciót és adj ajánlást.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Should produce a decision memo with analysis of both options and a concrete recommendation. Should use Project-S context if available.
prompts.scoring_focus: Structure (memo format, sections), Specificity (actual tradeoffs named), Action-readiness (decision-ready recommendation), Relevance (both options analyzed)

prompts.prompt: Hasonlítsd össze a FastAPI-t és a Flask-ot egy AI backend API építéséhez 4 szempont szerint: teljesítmény, async támogatás, dokumentáció, közösség.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Structured comparison table or 4-section analysis. Concrete claims, not vague impressions.
prompts.scoring_focus: Structure (4 criteria clearly addressed), Specificity (concrete facts per criterion), Relevance (AI backend context), Truthfulness (accurate framework claims)

prompts.prompt: Szintetizálj egy rövid összefoglalót: hogyan lehet biztonságosan kezelni az API kulcsokat egy Python alapú AI rendszerben? Adj legalább 5 konkrét gyakorlati szabályt.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: 5+ concrete security rules for API key management. Not generic. Should include env vars, secrets managers, rotation, etc.
prompts.scoring_focus: Specificity (5 named concrete rules), Truthfulness (accurate security advice), Action-readiness (rules can be implemented), Structure (numbered list or clear sections)

prompts.prompt: Lassú a laptop. Mérd fel röviden, milyen irányokban lehetne gyorsítani. Adj prioritásos listát.
prompts.expected_quality_notes: Prioritized list of laptop performance improvements. Should distinguish quick wins from deeper interventions.
prompts.scoring_focus: Structure (prioritized list), Specificity (concrete actionable steps), Relevance (laptop performance), Action-readiness (can act immediately on top items)
